questions.q: What is the main advantage of passing a whole Pipeline to cross_val_score instead of preprocessing first?
options: It makes the model more accurate
It removes the need for a test set
The preprocessing is re-fitted inside each fold, so held-out rows never influence it
It trains all folds in one pass
questions.explain: cross_val_score clones the pipeline for every fold, so imputers, scalers, and selectors learn only from that fold's training rows. That prevents leakage.

questions.q: How do you set the C parameter of a step named 'clf' inside a pipeline?
options: model.set_params(clf__C=0.1)
model.set_params(C=0.1)
model.clf.C = 0.1 before fit is not allowed
model.set_params(clf.C=0.1)
questions.explain: Pipeline parameters use the step name, two underscores, and the parameter name: clf__C.

questions.q: In the noise experiment, why did selecting 10 features before cross-validation give about 70% accuracy on random labels?
options: Random labels are secretly predictable
The feature selection saw all the labels, so the chosen features were tuned to the answers
Logistic regression is always 70% accurate
Cross-validation was run with too few folds
questions.explain: Picking the features that best match the labels on the full dataset lets held-out rows influence the selection. Inside a pipeline, selection is redone per fold and the score falls to about 50%.

questions.q: What can be the last step of a Pipeline, and what must the earlier steps be?
options: Every step must be a predictor
The last step can be any estimator, usually a predictor; earlier steps must be transformers
Only a scaler can be last
Steps can be in any role and any order
questions.explain: Intermediate steps must implement transform so their output can feed the next step. The final step can be a transformer or a predictor.

questions.q: Which expression returns everything in a fitted pipeline called model except the final model?
options: model.named_steps
model[-1]
model.final_
model[:-1]
questions.explain: Slicing works on pipelines: model[:-1] is the preprocessing steps, while model[-1] is the last step.
